IN THE HIGH COURT OF ANDHRA PRADESH :: AMARAVATI  WRIT PETITION No.13431 of 2018  PROCEEDING SHEET Sl. OFFICE No. DATE ORDER NOTE 4. 29.12.2025 NJS, J  W.P. No.13431 of 2018  Perused the docket proceedings dated  22.12.2025.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF ANDHRA PRADESH :: AMARAVATI
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Instead of filing counter affidavit,
 Mr.K.Arjun Chowdary, learned Assistant Government  Pleader, placed a copy of the written instructions  dated 27.12.2025 received from the respondent No.3 for perusal of the Court.

He submits that as per the material enclosed to the said instructions, the respondent No.2 invoked the provision under Section 19(7) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and therefore, the draft declaration is within the extended period.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: He seeks further time to file counter affidavit of respondent No.2.

With much reluctance, this Court is inclined to grant a week's time, however subject to payment of costs of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees ten thousand only) to the A.P. High Court Legal Services Committee,
within a period of one week.

entities.text: A.P. High Court Legal Services Committee
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: In the event, the counter affidavit is not filed by the date of next adjournment, the respondent No.2 shall appear before this Court.
